mapper.insert: insert into sys_plant ( sys_id, plant_cd, plant_nm, use_yn, delete_yn, insert_datetime, insert_user_id, emp_nm, phone_number, reg_num ) values ( #{sysId}, #{businessRegiNum}, #{plantNm}, 'Y', 'N', now(), #{userId}, #{userNm}, #{phoneNumber}, #{businessRegiNum} )

insert into sys_user ( sys_id , user_id , user_nm , user_password , email , email_valid_yn , init_yn , password_fail_cnt , delete_yn, insert_user_id , insert_datetime, plant_cd, user_role ) values ( #{sysId}, #{userId}, #{userNm}, #{password}, #{email} , 'Y', 'N', 0, 'N', #{userId}, now(), #{businessRegiNum}, '01' )
mapper.select: select count(*) > 0 from sys_user where 1=1 and user_id = #{userId} and delete_yn = 'N'
